description: SU(2), j <= 44: per highest-weight sector with graviton classes (125 sectors), the number of graviton classes (grav, from data/su2/bmn_hw_cohomology_j44.json) and of Coulomb-type ones (coulomb = rank of the graviton hw vectors on Cartan-valued letters, where Q-exact operators vanish); noncoulomb = grav - coulomb. Result: 166 graviton classes, all Coulomb-type; no non-Coulomb graviton in SU(2) through j = 44.
command: cd code; python -m fortuity.hwcoh.noncoulomb SU 2 2 OUT ../data/su2/bmn_hw_cohomology_j44.json
checked: a zero non-Coulomb count is exact (random evaluation can only lower the Cartan rank); the same module reproduces the other files of data/noncoulomb (README.meta.json)
